_comment: THE registry of the mechanical setups a book Trading System is composed of (CLAUDE.md §13-§14: Methodology != Setup != Trading System). One reader: scripts/registry.py. A setup is one explicit, independently testable rule; its code is named in `rule_ref` and is the ONE definition the research measured and the executor trades. The interpretive methodologies (ICT, Wyckoff, Footprint, Heatmap) and their pilot setups stay in docs/architecture/methods.json and docs/architecture/pilot-selection.json; this file holds the setups of books.
_evidence_statuses_why: Per (setup, instrument), because evidence is per instrument: G9 survived on both metals, but G9 silver failed the pass-policy replay (67-87 % first-attempt fail 2021-23) and is watched on paper only. An APPROVED book version may only hold components whose instrument status is VALIDATED (scripts/registry.py validate). A status changes only with a new audit named in `evidence_ref`.

fvg_retrace.name: Displacement fair value gap retrace
fvg_retrace.what: A three-bar displacement leaves a gap; the retrace into its near edge is traded with a time exit.

intraday_trend.name: Intraday trend breakout
intraday_trend.what: A breakout through the previous server day's range in the direction of the move, held to the rollover.

E5.what: LIMIT at the near edge of an untouched displacement FVG known at its third bar's close; stop 2 x sigma_5m x sqrt(hold_bars); time exit after hold_bars; flat before the rollover; one filled trade per (symbol, server day, side).
E5.evidence_ref: docs/audits/2026-10-03-e5-lookahead-erratum.md (the earlier evidence, docs/audits/2026-10-02-fvg-book-sim.md, rested on a look-ahead selection; under the executor's point-in-time selection E5 has no edge: docs/audits/2026-10-03-e5-live-fill.md)

H7.what: MARKET entry at the bar after the first close beyond the previous server day's high (low) with the 20-day momentum; stop 2 sigma x sqrt(bars to the rollover); closed before the rollover.

G9.what: MARKET entry at the bar after the first close beyond the open +/- 0.5 x the previous dense day's range; stop 2 sigma x sqrt(bars to the rollover); closed before the rollover.
